alias_check_scope: Exploratory comparison to supplied Wells cross-references after inference; shared source metadata, not independent glyph verification.

validation.logloss_policy: Known source IDs only; additive 0.5 over training Parpola IDs plus UNK; unseen target IDs collapse to UNK. Unseen source positions remain explicit prediction failures.

test.logloss_policy: Known source IDs only; additive 0.5 over training Parpola IDs plus UNK; unseen target IDs collapse to UNK. Unseen source positions remain explicit prediction failures.

limitation: No independent face/glyph/object verification. Shared source ancestry, small holdout and segmentation exclusions limit inference. No sounds, meanings or automatic sign merging.
